# Getting help

- **How do I…?** Ask in [Discussions › Q&A](https://github.com/anubhav-qt/breader/discussions/categories/q-a).
- **Something's broken.** Open a [bug report](https://github.com/anubhav-qt/breader/issues/new?template=bug.yml).
- **I have an idea.** Share it in [Discussions › Ideas](https://github.com/anubhav-qt/breader/discussions/categories/ideas).
- **I found a security problem.** Report it privately, as [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md) says.

Breader is made by one person in their spare time, so answers can take a few days.
